name: sharp-guardkill
help: Disable Windows Credential Guard at runtime via LSA ISO teardown event and confirm completion...by @Vulndisclosure
long_help:
Signals the internal \LSA_ISO_DISABLE_CREDENTIAL_GUARD event as SYSTEM to unload CredGuard from LsaIso.exe, then polls NtOpenEvent to prove the teardown completed.

Requirements:
  - Beacon must be x64 and running as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
  - VBS must be enabled and CredGuard must be configured
  - No arguments are taken; the tool exits with a status code that encodes the result

Exit codes:
  0  - CredGuard disabled (or already disabled, teardown confirmed)
  1  - SYSTEM impersonation failed (missing privileges)
  3  - Signal delivered but event did not disappear within 10s (teardown incomplete)
  4  - Failed to open the event (likely ACCESS_DENIED)
  5  - NtSetEvent failed
  99 - Unexpected result
